instruction: Change the font of the last paragraph in the course outline to Arial.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully selected the last paragraph and applied strikethrough formatting via Format > Text > Strikethrough menu, then saved the document.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer menus, select text paragraphs using click+Ctrl+Shift+End, apply text formatting via Format menu, save documents with Ctrl+S.
metadata.task_rationale: Variation tests font change instead of strikethrough, targeting the same last paragraph. Requires selecting text and changing font via toolbar or Format > Character menu.
metadata.explanation: Task asks agent to change the last paragraph font to Arial. Getter reads the docx and extracts font names of runs in the last non-empty paragraph (paragraph_index=-1). Metric checks if at least 90% of characters use Arial font. [Fixed: changed paragraph_index from hardcoded 2 to -1 to correctly target the last non-empty paragraph; updated getter to support negative indexing.]

scoring_breakdown.font_change: 1.0 - At least 90% of last paragraph characters use Arial font

fix_history: Fix 1: Changed paragraph_index from hardcoded 2 to -1 to correctly target the last non-empty paragraph instead of the 3rd one
Fix 2: Updated getter to support negative indexing with proper bounds checking

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses paragraph_index=-1 with Python negative indexing to select the last non-empty paragraph, matching the instruction's 'last paragraph' requirement.
Getter properly filters non-empty paragraphs and has bounds checking for negative indices (line 21).
Metric correctly accesses expected.get('expected_font') directly from the rules dict, proper handling for type='rule'.
90% character-level font matching threshold is reasonable — allows for minor whitespace-only runs or style-inherited fragments.
Postconfig correctly activates the Writer window and saves the document with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads fresh file state.

Minor concern: run.font.name returns None for style-inherited fonts (mapped to 'default'), which could slightly reduce the matched ratio if some runs inherit font rather than having it explicitly set. However, explicit font changes in LibreOffice typically set run-level fonts, so this is acceptable.
